name: llm-gateway-copilot-proxy
description: VS Code extension that connects GitHub Copilot language models to llm-gateway.

commands.title: LLM Gateway Copilot Proxy: Show Output

llmGatewayCopilotProxy.gatewayUrl.description: Gateway WebSocket URL for Copilot proxy connections.

llmGatewayCopilotProxy.proxyToken.description: Scoped Copilot proxy token issued by llm-gateway.

llmGatewayCopilotProxy.enableGatewayAuth.description: Enable gateway token auth for the proxy WebSocket connection. When false, the extension connects without the token query parameter and proxyToken is not required.

llmGatewayCopilotProxy.logLevel.description: Minimum log level for the Copilot proxy output channel. Use debug for diagnostic metadata; prompt and response text are never logged.

scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out dist/llm-gateway-copilot-proxy-0.1.0.vsix
